definitions.full: H790. Eshban אֶשְׁבָּן proper name, masculine a chief of Edom Gen 36:26 ; 1Chr 1:41 (etymology dubious, ᵐ5 Ἀσβαν , Ἐσεβαν , Ἀσεβων ). אַשְׁבֵּעַ see שׁבע . p. 959 f אֶשְׁבַּעַל see אִישׁבּֿשֶׁת . אשׁד (√ of following, compare probably Assyrian išdu , foundation ).
definitions.rootNote: probably from the same as 7644 ; vigorous ;
